prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for all tested change types (finish new_screen, sign_in incentive, home wait_info, choose_path copy) as each has only one test so far.
Predictions were consistently too high across all round 1 tests compared to noise-corrected measurements.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- choose_path, copy: +0.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: -0.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, incentive: -3.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Split-Screen Pet Personality Customizer: Redesign the pet selection screen into a split-screen layout with live pet animation previews on the left and trait toggles on the right. (why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 60.9% and a long mean duration of 1017s. Clear split-screen options streamline decision-making.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Account Sign-In Flow: Move the sign_in screen to occur after pet selection and adoption certificate creation, right before pet rendering. (why: Sign-in conversion is 72.9% with mean duration 567s. Letting users pick and name their pet first increases emotional commitment before requiring authentication.)
2: [home, new_flow] Interactive Pet Summoning Wait Flow: Transform the waiting screen into a dynamic stage mini-flow showing interactive hatching animations while the desktop asset builds. (why: The waiting screen ('home' step) has a long mean completion time of 2336s and 18.7% drop-off. Interactive animations keep users engaged during setup.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Cloud Save Account Safety Copy Reassurance: Update sign-in headline and body to highlight account security and guaranteed pet save restoration. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, causing user anxiety during authentication.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Two-Column Path Choice Cards: Reorganize path selection into a structured two-column comparison card layout distinguishing instant pre-made pets from custom design. (why: choose_path drop-off is 23.8% and takes mean 514s, indicating confusion between onboarding options.)
5: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Quality Compatibility Hint: Add an explicit photo formatting hint and guidance badge to the photo upload screen. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual artifacts.)
6: [home, wait_info] Real-Time Render Progress & Estimator: Enable real-time percentage progress bar and estimated completion time on the waiting screen. (why: Home step waiting time has a median of 201s and mean of 2336s; transparent progress updates prevent early abandoned sessions.)
7: [finish, layout] Spotlight Desktop Controls Welcome Layout: Change home_intro layout to spotlight mode with quick control shortcuts (hide, talk, move) prominently detailed. (why: 3 support emails highlighted confusion over controlling, hiding, or talking to pets after onboarding.)

scores.note: Adoption has high drop-off (39.1%), but full screen redesign requires new assets and build.
Reordering sign-in builds early intent, though flow changes require careful routing.
Interactive minigame during load reduces boredom, but high dev cost for low-drop step.
Strong evidence from 8 support emails; simple copy config change with good ROI.
Two-column comparison clarifies path choice, low risk layout update.
Addresses adoption step drop-off and 3 support emails via easy hint/badge config.
Previous test on home wait_info showed -0.3% lift; low confidence.
Finish step loses 35.2% and has 3 support emails; layout spotlight clarifies post-onboarding controls.
